118002.name: Ohel Chabad Lubavitch
118002.note: Wikipedia (Ohel): 'In 1995, Lubavitcher Hasidim bought one of these houses and turned it into a 24-hour visitors center' (226-20 Francis Lewis Blvd., beside the Rebbe's resting place). The IRS recognized Cong Ohel Chabad Lubavitch at that address from August 1998 (ProPublica). Medium: one secondary source for the year.

118366.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Kingsborough College
118366.note: COLlive (6 Oct 2016, 'Kingsborough Chabad Celebrates 18'): 'Some 18 years ago Chabad at Kingsborough was established at Kingsborough Community College. That summer it held a Day Camp' (so about 1998). Medium: a count back. Rabbi Efraim and Hannah Zaltzman.
